shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, fabric, metal and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, collars, bags, vehicles, plates and walls. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen.

assets.item: Small / It is a small dog.

reference_file.observed_description: In a bright empty room with a light wooden floor and a plain pale wall a huge fawn Great Dane with a red collar sits upright beside a light-oak slatted dining chair; the top of the dog's head is clearly higher than the chair's backrest and its body is wider than the chair. One dog, one chair, a strip of window at the far left edge; no people, text or other objects.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows a very big dog sitting beside a wooden chair. Keep the room, the floor, the wall, the light, the camera position and the wooden chair exactly as they are, with the chair in the same place and at the same size in the frame. REMOVE the big dog completely and put a very SMALL dog in its place: one tiny adult chihuahua with a short fawn coat and a thin plain red collar, sitting upright on the floor right beside the chair, turned three-quarters toward the camera, mouth closed. The little dog is tiny next to the chair: the top of its head is clearly LOWER than the chair's seat, at about half the height of the seat, and it is much narrower than the chair. It is a real small adult dog, not a puppy, a toy or a statue, and it is sharp and easy to recognise as a dog. Exactly one dog and one chair; no people, no other animals and no toys.

reference_file.observed_description: A spotless glossy dark-blue five-door hatchback is parked alone on a clean pale concrete driveway in front of a plain beige garage door, seen from the front left; bright reflections, clear headlights, shiny silver wheels, clean black tires, a blank white front plate and no badge. No people, other vehicles, text or dirt.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows a brand-new blue car. Keep the same car model, the same blue color, the same camera angle, the same position and size in the frame, and the same driveway and garage wall. Show the SAME car many years later as a clearly USED car. The wear is obvious at a glance even when the photo is very small. It is an ordinary used car that still drives: nothing is broken off, crashed, burnt or missing, the glass is whole and all four tires are full. The front plate stays a blank plain white rectangle. Exactly one car; no people, no other vehicles, no price tag and no signs.
